title: Land Inheritance
source_topic: ICPC / The 2017 ACM - Asia Ho Chi Minh City Regional Contest
statement: A simple polygon of at most one hundred integer-coordinate vertices is split by a straight canal line; one brother owns everything on one side and the other brother everything on the other, and these regions may be disconnected. The two brothers plant fields that must be exact mirror images of each other across the canal. The task is the largest possible area of one brother's field.
